result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but there are a few visual issues around clipped horizontal content and content being obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The restaurant content near the bottom is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar. The pizza card image is cut off by the nav, making the page feel unfinished or overlapped.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable sections show awkwardly clipped items at the right edge, including the category chips and the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding, a fade indicator, or adjust carousel snapping so partially visible items look intentional and are not abruptly cropped.

issues.description: The partially visible restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' row is truncated as 'Smash Bros Bu', which looks visually incomplete in the current viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated cards use a clear ellipsis or only reveal enough of the next card image without exposing incomplete text.
